analyst_view.overall: Excelsior (13th, 14 points) host Telstar (16th, 10 points) in a match between relegation rivals; Telstar coach Henk Brugge has called these year-end games ones where points must be won. Excelsior, under Ruben den Uil, ended a run of four defeats (including 0-9 at Twente) by winning 3-2 at Feyenoord on 21 November, while Telstar lost 1-3 at home to PEC Zwolle the same weekend after four points from the two games before. Telstar have several players out or doubtful: Seedorf was hurt in a friendly against Antwerp, Krastev (Achilles), Rahajaan and Floranus are out, and reports differ on whether Alders and Mendes are fit; for Excelsior, forward Sliti is listed as doubtful. The numbers had no team news for this match, so none of this is counted, but the absences are spread across both ends of the pitch and do not clearly move the totals; Excelsior's cup tie at Willem II three days later may bring some rotation, though the league game is likely to come first, and no referee has been named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals and already add Telstar's 14 goals in their last six and Excelsior's 22 conceded in that run (the 0-9 at Twente included). Telstar's missing players include both attackers (Seedorf, possibly Mendes) and defenders (Floranus, Rahajaan, possibly Alders), so their absences push both ways; the last two meetings both ended 2-2, in line with the numbers, so I stay at about 3.4.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners and already trim Excelsior's share for their few corners lately. I found nothing on tactics or line-ups that the numbers can't see, so I stay at about 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.7 cards and take a little off Telstar for being booked less lately; no referee has been named yet. This is a six-pointer near the bottom that Telstar's coach has called a must-win, and the numbers carry no stakes adjustment for it, so I lean mildly higher, to about 2.8.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.3 shots and already move Excelsior down (-12.5%) and Telstar up (+9.9%) for recent form. Excelsior's 3-2 win at Feyenoord suggests some life in their attack, while Telstar may miss Seedorf and Mendes up front; these roughly balance, so I stay at about 26.3.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.9 shots on target and already count Excelsior's poor accuracy lately (12 on target in six) and Telstar's better run (37). The absences on both sides cut both ways, so I stay at about 9.9.
